info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

x-openregister.description: Shillinq — open-source business administration suite for Dutch SMB, ZZP, and government.

example.title: Example
example.description: Example schema — replace with your app's actual schemas.

title.description: The title of the example object

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

Iv3Export.title: IV3 Export
Iv3Export.description: Quarterly Informatie voor Derden (IV3) export to CBS per Wet Fido art. 8 + Besluit BBV art. 71. Covers generation, validation, CBS submission and acceptance for municipal administrations.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this IV3 export.

reportingYear.description: Calendar year of the reporting period.

iv3Version.description: CBS IV3 specification version used for this export.

buckets.description: Aggregated IV3 bucket values keyed by IV3 bucket code (derived via x-openregister-aggregations).

state.description: Lifecycle state of the IV3 export.

xmlAttachmentUri.description: Docudesk URI of the generated CBS IV3 XML file.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the IV3 export was generated.

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the IV3 export was submitted to CBS.

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when CBS accepted the IV3 export.

cbsMessageId.description: CBS-side message identifier returned on submission.

correctionOf.description: FK to a prior Iv3Export.id that this export supersedes as a correction.

retention.description: Verantwoording-naar-derden records retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: IV3 export has been generated from closed GL postings; awaiting XML validation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: XML payload validated against the CBS IV3 schema; awaiting submission approval.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: IV3 export dispatched to CBS via the cbs-iv3 OpenConnector source.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: CBS rejected the IV3 export; operator must correct and revalidate.

corrected.label: Corrected
corrected.description: A correction export (correctionOf set) supersedes this accepted export.

validate.label: Validate XML
validate.description: Validate the generated XML payload against the CBS IV3 schema.

submit.label: Submit to CBS
submit.description: Dispatch the validated export to CBS via the cbs-iv3 OpenConnector source.

accept.label: Mark Accepted
accept.description: CBS accepted the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 event).

reject.label: Mark Rejected
reject.description: CBS rejected the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 event).

revalidate.label: Revalidate after Fix
revalidate.description: After correcting the export content, revalidate before re-submitting.

correct.label: Mark Corrected
correct.description: A new Iv3Export with correctionOf set supersedes this export.

bucketsByIv3Code.description: SUM of (debit - credit) over GLLine rows for the export's quarter, grouped by BbvAccountMapping.iv3Bucket. Restricted to closed periods (via bookkeeping-period-close). Used to populate the buckets field.

iv3XmlMapping.description: OR Mapping transformation that serialises the Iv3Export.buckets aggregation into the CBS IV3-bestand XML schema. Declarative-first per ADR-031. ADR-031 exception path: if the OR Mapping engine cannot express CBS mixed-content XML nodes, a single-method thin renderer Iv3XmlRenderer::render() (~30 LOC) is permitted — see openspec/changes/add-shillinq-iv3-reporting/design.md D3.

quarterlyIv3Submission.description: Quarterly scheduled workflow that generates and submits IV3 exports for all gemeente/provincie/waterschap administrations whose prior quarter is closed. Invokes the cbs-iv3 OpenConnector source per ADR-019 — no app-local HTTP client.
quarterlyIv3Submission.cronDescription: 1st of January, April, July, October at 00:00 UTC

steps.description: Submit validated IV3 export to CBS via the cbs-iv3 OpenConnector source.
